svg.title: When a file stands for a document
svg.desc: A file that the user can open has [P412] in its name. Without an archive account, there is no document, and Paperless isn't asked. With one, the owner of the file decides: when the archive account doesn't own the file, it stands for no document, because anyone could name a file so. When the archive account owns it, as its own file or one it shared, the user sees document 412 with its title and its excerpt.
